title: merge --batch-build refuses a lane that changes a guard or check unless it is the batch's only lane
why: merge --batch-build let degen #584, which changes a guard or check, join a mixed batch (#643 with #616); degen's other runner then closed batch 23k (batch runner 11, reported by the coordinator 23:50 CST Nov 11).
source: coordinator 23:50 CST Nov 11, from batch runner 11
note: Code change in the merge tool; a real incident, so a step.
